title: Section 103 — Punishment for murder — Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023

content.heading: Punishment for murder
content.text: Section 103 BNS punishes murder. Read the official notified text on India Code. This record identifies the current-law provision corresponding to historical IPC 302.
content.historicalNotes: Current law for offences on or after 1 July 2024. Not a 1:1 reprint of IPC 302.
